<?php
class QuietMixedRead {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed { echo "G;"; if ($incoming === "zero") { return "0"; } if ($incoming === "false") { return false; } return null; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { global $written; echo "S;"; $written = $value; }
}
function quietMixedRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$written = 42;
$receiver = new QuietMixedRead;
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietMixedRhs()) === "0" ? "STRING;" : "BAD_STRING;";
$selector = "false";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietMixedRhs()) === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
$selector = "none";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietMixedRhs()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietMixedRhs()) === 9 ? "ASSIGN;" : "BAD_ASSIGN;";
echo $written === 9 ? "SET;" : "BAD_SET;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietMixedRhs()) === 9 ? "SKIP;" : "BAD_SKIP;";
echo $selector === "none" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
$receiver = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): mixed { global $receiver; echo "G;"; $receiver = null; return null; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-mixed"); }
};
function quietMixedThrowRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$weak = WeakReference::create($receiver);
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->$selector ?? quietMixedThrowRhs(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $weak->get() === null ? "DEAD;" : "BAD_LIVE;";
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $receiver === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class StrictQuietMixedRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): mixed { echo "G;"; return 42.5; }
}
function quietMixedFloatRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new StrictQuietMixedRead;
$selector = "value";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "BAD_EMPTY;" : "NONEMPTY;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietMixedFloatRhs()) === 42.5 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class MixedLiteralPayload { public function __destruct() { echo "RV;"; } }
class MixedLiteralReceiver {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed { global $receiver, $value; echo "G;"; $saved = $value; $value = null; $receiver = null; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$value = new MixedLiteralPayload;
$receiver = new MixedLiteralReceiver;
echo empty($receiver->object) ? "BAD_OBJECT;" : "OBJECT;";
$value = [new MixedLiteralPayload];
$receiver = new MixedLiteralReceiver;
echo empty($receiver->array) ? "BAD_ARRAY;" : "ARRAY;";
echo $receiver === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $value === null ? "VALUE_CLEAR;" : "BAD_VALUE;";
echo "DONE;";
